accion: Extreme close-up, low angle: the book's glove shakes the mate's glove in the center; a red bicycle out of focus behind; sparkle where the hands meet.
Medium shot: he looks into the camera with a curious raised eyebrow, hand on chin.
Wide shot: the mate proudly presents a shiny red bicycle like a salesman; the book looks at it curious.
Medium shot: the book raises a glove palm forward in a 'wait, wait' gesture, skeptical frown.
He presents the plain red hardcover book, glowing with golden light, with an elegant gesture.
A blue-gold hologram of two luminous clasped hands floats above; book and mate look up amazed.
Dimmed stage lights: each character under its own spotlight, facing each other, pointing proudly at themselves.
The mate hands the bicycle by the handlebar to the book, the book hands a plain brown envelope; sparkle trail.
The book happily rides the red bicycle; the mate waves goodbye holding the plain envelope.
The book wobbles carrying an absurdly tall stack of blank papers; the man looks amused, hand on hip.
He raises his index finger with a knowing smile, golden sparkle at the fingertip.
Blank papers fly away like a flock of birds toward the window; the book raises both gloves in relief.
He gestures to a hologram: a small glowing house with a red wax seal on top, a glowing bicycle floating free below.
Group shot: the man explains to camera, the book sits on the bicycle, the mate gives a thumbs up.
The man points up triumphantly; the highlighter stands fully in frame with a thumbs up and a glowing yellow streak on the floor; empty space above for the card.
